# Screen

`cinnabar:extension/screen@0.1.0`

The mod's JSON-UI templates beside the vanilla container screens. Templates are the
`ui/<name>.json` files `mod.toml` indexes, in the mod's own namespace; they resolve only
against the vanilla catalog, as a client part's modal templates do. Every
mutation errs when the `screen` permission is denied.

**Grants:** `screen` for mutations; layout, held-modifiers and elapsed-seconds need no grant.

Imported type `value`: [`value`](server-experience-ui.md#type-value).

Imported type `gui-size`: [`gui-size`](server-experience-ui.md#type-gui-size).

## Types

<a id="type-rect"></a>

### `rect`

A rectangle in GUI units, from the top left of the screen root.

```wit
record rect {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `f64` |  |
| `y` | `f64` |  |
| `width` | `f64` |  |
| `height` | `f64` |  |

<a id="type-screen-layout"></a>

### `screen-layout`

The open container screen as laid out for this frame.

```wit
record screen-layout {
    screen: string,
    size: gui-size,
    gui: rect,
    exclusions: list<rect>,
    view: option<rect>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `screen` | `string` | The vanilla JSON-UI screen drawn, such as `crafting.inventory_screen`. |
| `size` | `gui-size` | The root's size in GUI units and the GUI scale, as `ui.modal-size` reports them. |
| `gui` | `rect` | The union of the vanilla screen's laid-out panels, an open recipe book included. |
| `exclusions` | `list<rect>` | Other vanilla areas outside `gui` that the overlay may not draw on: the recipe book's<br>tabs, the status effects and toasts. |
| `view` | `option<rect>` | The open view's laid-out bounds. While the view is up the vanilla screen is hidden,<br>and the overlay is clipped against this rect (and the exclusions) instead of `gui`. |

Types: [`gui-size`](server-experience-ui.md#type-gui-size), [`rect`](screen.md#type-rect).

## Functions

<a id="layout"></a>

### `layout`

```wit
layout: func() -> option<screen-layout>;
```

The open container screen's layout; none while no container screen is up.

Types: [`screen-layout`](screen.md#type-screen-layout).

<a id="set-overlay"></a>

### `set-overlay`

```wit
set-overlay: func(template: option<string>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Draws `template` beside every container screen, laid out over the whole root but drawn
and hit only outside `gui` and the exclusions; none removes it.

<a id="open-view"></a>

### `open-view`

```wit
open-view: func(template: option<string>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Draws `template` over the open container screen, which stays open and is hidden while
the view is up; none, Escape or closing the container returns. Errs while no container
screen is up.

<a id="set-collection"></a>

### `set-collection`

```wit
set-collection: func(name: string, rows-json: list<u8>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces a collection's rows, as client WIT 1.2's `ui.set-collection`.

<a id="set-value"></a>

### `set-value`

```wit
set-value: func(name: string, value: value) -> result<_, string>;
```

Binds one `#binding` name for the overlay and the view, as `ui.set-value`.

Types: [`value`](server-experience-ui.md#type-value).

<a id="set-text"></a>

### `set-text`

```wit
set-text: func(control: string, text: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Sets the text of edit boxes named `control`, as `ui.set-text`.

<a id="focus-text"></a>

### `focus-text`

```wit
focus-text: func(control: string) -> result<_, string>;
```

Selects the drawn edit box named `control`, as a press on it would.

<a id="held-modifiers"></a>

### `held-modifiers`

```wit
held-modifiers: func() -> modifiers;
```

The modifier keys held with the event being delivered, such as Shift with a press.

Types: [`modifiers`](screen.md#type-modifiers).

<a id="elapsed-seconds"></a>

### `elapsed-seconds`

```wit
elapsed-seconds: func() -> f64;
```

Monotonic seconds since the mod loaded, to animate by, as JEI cycles ingredients.
